purpose: Six-domain PSD3/PSR readiness rubric: Open Finance access rights (Art.35/36), TPP categorisation (PISP/AISP/PIISP), SCA exemption alignment (Art.85–90), consent framework maturity, fraud liability model (Art.59–65), and embedded finance/BaaS scope. Radar chart + prioritised gap table. Root node (no upstream dependency). Feeds ART-04 (DORA Mapper) and PTG-01. EU transposition ~2027; UK PSR enacted 2024.
